title: SentinelReconfigurationStatusEvent
description: Schema for Service Manager message SM4. This event publishes the updated Sentinel reconfiguration status after the Service Manager updates its registry based on a received Sentinel reconfiguration status message.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be sentinelReconfigurationStatusEvent.

originator.description: Property. Component that generated the event.

messageId.description: Property. Unique identifier of this published message.

timestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the Sentinel reconfiguration status event was generated.

relatedSentinel.description: Relationship. Sentinel entity whose reconfiguration status has been updated.

relatedOverwatch.description: Relationship. Overwatch entity associated with the Sentinel.

reconfigurationStatus.description: Property. Current reconfiguration execution status of the Sentinel. Example: SUCCESS.

configurationVersion.description: Property. Configuration name or version currently associated with the Sentinel after reconfiguration.
